items.title: When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
items.summary: CodeSpecWeave synthesizes complex, interdependent software development tasks with verified tests to train coding agents, improving performance on long-horizon benchmarks.

items.title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
items.summary: MemSteer generates evidence-grounded QA supervision from unlabeled user histories to optimize agent memory design without model updates, improving benchmark scores significantly.

items.title: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
items.summary: SciGame evaluates scientific discovery agents using structured cards with counterfactual environments to separate prior knowledge from empirical evidence, revealing that exact symbolic law recovery remains a key challenge.

items.title: Matched Capabilities, Different Behaviors: A Controlled Study of MCP and CLI Interfaces for Language Agents
items.summary: Matched interface representations significantly alter agent behavior despite identical executable capabilities, and targeted repair of interface-specific realization improves performance while reducing cost.

items.title: REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
items.summary: REA unifies deliberative and reactive policies in a single runtime with asynchronous coordination, achieving high success rates with reduced control overhead across simulated and real robot tasks.

items.title: HALO: Human-Grounded Granular Evaluation of Proactive Agents
items.summary: HALO introduces a human-annotated benchmark and dataset to evaluate proactive agents, revealing that over-proactivity is the dominant failure mode.

items.title: CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: CEPO improves multi-agent prompt optimization by separating shared coordination from agent-specific execution, boosting performance across benchmarks and scaling efficiently with more agents.

items.title: R^2Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
items.summary: R²Orch uses recursive self-play with learnable task selection and skill withdrawal to train orchestrators without hand-designed curricula, improving performance across reasoning and interactive tasks.

items.title: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
items.summary: CaPtain trains small open vision-language models via supervised fine-tuning and multi-turn reinforcement learning with a physical critic to perform robot manipulation through code, achieving strong results without frontier models or vision-language-action backbones.

items.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
items.summary: RoboArchitect automates robot harness design by iteratively revising control code around a frozen policy, substantially improving success on unseen scenes and tasks without model updates.

items.title: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
items.summary: Quality-Controllable Policy enables real-time adjustment of robot execution quality and improves performance through iterative hindsight relabeling of online rollouts.

items.title: VoxLock: Target-Speaker Extraction for Voice Agents Without an Enrollment Step
items.summary: A fine-tuned causal target-speaker extraction model achieves near-commercial speech recognition accuracy on real recordings with low CPU usage and latency.

items.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
items.summary: Apriel Voice 27B Preview is an open speech-language model that integrates speech understanding, reasoning, and tool use within a shared backbone, achieving strong results on audio benchmarks through a two-stage training procedure with online distillation.

items.title: On the Origin and Evolution of Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: On-policy reinforcement learning for large language models suffers from training-inference mismatch due to numerical discrepancies and policy lag, and a derived discrepancy-lag correction stabilizes training by centering errors, clipping importance ratios, and resynchronizing sampling.

items.title: Broken on Arrival: Non-Functional Quantized LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them
items.summary: Quantized small language model files in public registries can be non-functional due to uncalibrated quantization recipes, and screening plus calibration is recommended before release.

items.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
items.summary: Foundation-model training stages can be unified under a single likelihood-based algorithm that blends static data and reinforcement learning generations, improving efficiency and capability retention.

items.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
items.summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures trained on aligned multi-modal observations converge to shared representations with far greater efficiency than next-token prediction, demonstrating that positive view design—not scale alone—drives cross-modal alignment.

items.title: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification
items.summary: EasyProver is a Lean proving system using recursive agents and asynchronous search that solves nearly all Putnam and IMO benchmark problems, while Aegis generates harder verification tasks from competitive programming to benchmark provers and support reinforcement learning.

items.title: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
items.summary: Investor's Last Exam evaluates financial agents on end-to-end equity research using frozen evidence, expert criteria, and dependency graphs, revealing that top models excel at research but fail at forecasting and investment judgments.

items.title: No Channels Left Behind: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration through Residual Gates
items.summary: Training acceleration in diffusion transformers is driven by reorganization of AdaLN-Zero residual gates, and a simple radial objective promoting broader gate participation improves generation quality without auxiliary teachers.

items.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
items.summary: LARC enables continuous latent reasoning for unified multimodal models, improving image generation quality and enabling test-time scaling without discrete token bottlenecks.

items.title: SketchDirector: Complex Scene Sketching via Agentic Layout Reasoning and Detail Refinement
items.summary: SketchDirector is an agentic framework that decomposes text prompts into draft vector assets, arranges them via iterative reasoning with self-evolving memory, and refines details using diffusion priors for complex scene sketching.

items.title: CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
items.summary: Causal World Action Models enforce sparse routing to isolate action-relevant latent variables, ensuring identifiable causal structure without requiring temporal independence assumptions.

items.title: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
items.summary: Co-designing a resource-heavy reasoning system with a lightweight predictive evaluator can reduce execution costs by filtering interactions, with efficiency governed by the density of useful interactions.

items.title: WorldBridge: Bridging Video and Action for Task Generalization in World Action Models
items.summary: WorldBridge improves robot task generalization by combining video prediction with sparse action supervision via separate video and action experts, achieving state-of-the-art results across manipulation benchmarks.

items.title: HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model
items.summary: HiFOR improves robotic manipulation by hierarchically predicting future states and retrieving relevant future information to guide action generation.

items.title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
items.summary: The study introduces EPSBench to evaluate AI agents in forecasting quarterly earnings by linking financial evidence to income-statement drivers and comparing model predictions to analyst consensus.

items.title: ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics
items.summary: ABF-Bench introduces an interactive, evidence-backed benchmark for blockchain fund tracing that evaluates adaptive agents against fixed tracers, revealing gaps in recall and overconfidence while enabling verifiable LLM agent training.

items.title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation
items.summary: OpenFlyV2 is a unified onboard vision-language-action model that enables real-time aerial navigation and reasoning on resource-constrained hardware using shared multimodal representations.

items.title: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
items.summary: An online reinforcement learning framework trains UI navigation agents on live mobile apps using a planning agent, UI grounding model, and a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method to improve robustness and reduce inference costs.

items.title: Supervising the Visible State: Separating Representation from View Selection in Streaming Video
items.summary: Visible-State Supervision and Test-Time Causal View Search improve streaming action recognition by separating representation learning from evidence selection, boosting accuracy with fewer frames.

items.title: Venus-DefakerOne2: A Vision-Forensics Foundation Model with Broader Coverage
items.summary: Venus-DefakerOne2 is a unified anti-forgery foundation model that extends detection to diverse forgery forms and media types through alternating LoRA and full-parameter tuning and entropy-based test adaptation.

items.title: TernScope: Model-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Ternary Endoscopic Segmentation
items.summary: TernScope co-designs a compact ternary-weight segmentation network with simplified hardware to achieve high accuracy and fast inference for edge medical imaging.

items.title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
items.summary: Visual foundation models vary in supporting persistent spatial states across structure, persistence, prediction, and action, with readout accuracy not guaranteeing history-based updates or reliable goal-directed progress.

items.title: Wizard: Manipulate Any World in Real Time via Agentic Control
items.summary: Wizard is an agentic game world model that uses structured motion proxies and adaptive masking to enable real-time, generalizable video generation with precise character control across diverse scenes.

items.title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
items.summary: WISD improves reasoning models by contrasting them with weaker quantized or pruned versions to generate training signals without privileged data.

items.title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
items.summary: Youtu-Parsing-Omni is a unified multi-modal parser that encodes documents, images, audio, and video into structured spatiotemporal records using shared weights and cross-modal fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results across parsing benchmarks through a self-evolving on-policy distillation procedure.

items.title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
items.summary: Soft-MTP removes a noisy gradient residual from multi-token prediction via a straight-through KL recovery trick, improving perplexity, speculative decoding, and reasoning without added cost.

items.title: ReLift: Dense 3D Tracking as Lifted Trajectory Repair
items.summary: ReLift improves dense 3D tracking by repairing and completing lifted trajectories using geometric trajectory refinement without requiring image-based training.

items.title: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
items.summary: FrameForge enables adaptive conditional image generation by modeling variable condition-target relationships through dynamic temporal experts and intermediate reasoning pathways in pretrained video models.

items.title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
items.summary: Pretrained raster-scan autoregressive image models can be adapted into flexible any-order generators via future-aware positional embeddings and an ordering curriculum, enabling inpainting and outpainting with minimal extra compute.

items.title: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
items.summary: Holo4D guides video diffusion with reconstructed 3D trajectory scaffolds to synthesize novel-view videos while preserving geometry and motion.

items.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
items.summary: L3G-World uses a compact latent 3D Gaussian memory and alternating autoregressive updates with a video diffusion transformer to generate spatially consistent interactive worlds in real time.

items.title: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
items.summary: Glance integrates reranking and generation into a single backbone using lightweight adapters and pointer heads to score passages from shared context, reducing memory overhead while improving retrieval and answer quality.

items.title: GLOW-FM: Efficient Generative Low-Light Image Enhancement with One-Step Latent Flow Matching
items.summary: GLOW-FM is a one-step latent flow-matching framework that enables efficient generative low-light image enhancement via single-function evaluation in a compact latent space.

items.title: WeFair: Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in Short-Video Search
items.summary: WeFair improves personalized query rewriting via fidelity-aware human feedback stages—demonstration, preference, and verification—to reduce intent drift and boost search effectiveness in short-video platforms.

items.title: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
items.summary: PhysInsert enables physically plausible object insertion by jointly adapting objects and scenes using geometry-guided adaptation and spatial supervision on aligned counterfactual data.

items.title: AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers
items.summary: AB-Attention approximates dense video diffusion attention with high sparsity via intra-block clustering, weighted sampling, and fine-grained kernel gathering, improving fidelity and speed.

items.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
items.summary: SpecSlot improves pixel-space generative Transformers by using localized spectral slots and restricted global attention to increase image detail without raising computational cost.

items.title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
items.summary: Formula-driven supervised metric learning uses continuous generative parameters to train embeddings with parameter-aware triplet loss, improving synthetic pre-training for image retrieval and robustness.
